findings.claim: The newly added full Needle checkout is pinned by its own .git metadata to cactus-compute/needle@6fdddb874dd6f46dabeea88d0bf239fc4a2474c4. The working tree outside .git contains exactly 40 leaf files; key local Git blob hashes match the upstream pinned commit.

Historical constrained decoding accepts a token once a closing quote is reached and ignores characters later in that same token; after a synthetic cross-boundary token drives the next constrained buffer off-trie, ConstrainedDecoder returns unconstrained logits. Exact SentencePiece vocabulary reachability remains untested because the binary tokenizer is not locally available.
Both no-valid-token and off-trie constrained-decoding error paths fail open to original logits rather than emitting abstention.

Tool-name normalization is non-injective and last-write-wins: variants such as foo-bar, foo.bar, foo bar and foo_bar collapse to one identity. The archived FRANK 51-active-tool set itself has no observed collision, so this is a registry-evolution hazard rather than a demonstrated historical FRANK failure.

At commit 6fdddb8 the constrained decoder expects flat Needle parameters. A standard-ish JSON Schema parameters.properties object constrains the literal key properties rather than its child argument; a full OpenAI function wrapper has no top-level name for this parser. Integration therefore requires an explicit versioned Clay-to-Needle projection rather than provider-schema pass-through.

Constrained decoding binds tool names and argument keys, but argument values are explicitly unconstrained and required/type/range semantics are not enforced. Strict deterministic post-decode validation is therefore mandatory.

The historical source uses a 1024-token encoder budget and truncates the serialized tool list from the tail after the query. The archived 51-active-tool verbose projection is about 11.9k characters while a minimal name+argument projection is about 3.5k characters. Exact tokenizer fit/order bias must be measured before freezing the projection.

The historical finetune path force-downloads needle.pkl by repository/name without a pinned revision and then deserializes it using Python pickle; run.py also directly pickle.loads checkpoints. This path is forbidden in the final authority zone. Current upstream availability of SafeTensors/Cactus is a preferable production candidate but still requires immutable revision/hash pinning.
TransformerConfig.__init__ silently discards unknown kwargs. Architecture-critical config must be strict-versioned and reject unknown/missing fields before weight loading.

Needle should remain the dedicated semantic router, but its output is an untrusted proposal. A deterministic versioned projection, strict validator, provenance binding and Clay Safe-Effect authority boundary are required. If full registry context does not fit, a measured Needle-only multi-stage/tournament scheme is a candidate that preserves Needle as semantic selector.
